title.narrative: EU-UNICEF partnership to strengthen national child protection system for prevention and protection of children from all forms of violence and exploitation

description.narrative: The project will support the efforts of the Government of Montenegro to strengthen child protection system to create safe and protective environment and enhance prevention and protection of children from violence, abuse, neglect and exploitation, especially after more than two years of COVID-19 pandemic. It aims to support Montenegro to develop the new National Strategy on Prevention and Protection of Children from Violence for the next five-years period and facilitate its implementation.
